Date 30 - 11 - 30.

Oct. 28, 1930.

F. W. Gerrard, Esq.,
Commissioner of Police,
Shanghai Municipal Council,
Shanghai.

Dear Commissioner Gerrard,

This is to thank you for your kind assistance
extended to us during Mr. Ha Wen-hu's stay
in Shanghai. The officers you assigned to
escort Mr. Ha did splendid service and words
are inadequate to express our sincere appreciation
for their assistance.

We wish to thank you also for issuing us the
permit for the six guards assigned by President
Chiang Kai-shek to pass the Settlement to
escort Mr. Ha to the North Station thence
to Nanking.

Mr. Ha has sailed for Hongkong on the S. S. Porthos
last Saturday, Oct. 25th. He wishes to express
his personal appreciation for your hospitality
and courtesy shown him.

Very sincerely yours,

(for approval)
Hoi
29/10

L. Shai Hsue, personal representative

Milton C. Lee

上海“BURECOM”
本特利密码
编号 S. B.-D. 1703。
电话：12704
日期 30 - 11 - 30。

1930年10月28日。

F. W. Gerrard 先生，
警务处处长，
上海工部局，
上海。

尊敬的Gerrard处长：

谨此感谢您在何文虎先生逗留上海期间给予我们的善意协助。您指派护送何先生的警官表现出色，言语不足以表达我们对他们协助的诚挚感激之情。

我们也感谢您签发许可证，允许蒋介石主席指派的六名警卫通过租界，护送何先生前往北站，继而赴南京。

何先生已于上周六（10月25日）乘“波尔多斯”号轮船（S. S. Porthos）启航前往香港。他希望亲自对您所给予的款待和礼遇表示谢意。

此致
敬礼

（待批）
Hoi
10月29日

李才学（音译），私人代表

Milton C. Lee

We wish to thank you also for issuing us the

Chiang Kai-shek to pass the Settlement to
escort Mr. Hu to the North Station thence to
Nanking.

Mr. Hu has sailed for Hongkong on the S. S.
Porthos last Saturday, Oct. 25th. He wishes
to express his personal appreciation for your
hospitality and courtesy shown him.

Very sincerely yours,

L. Shai Hone, personal representative
